items.source: Return this DataBlock as an InputStream.
items.translation: 将此 DataBlock` 返回为 InputStream`。

items.source: IOException - on I/O error
items.translation: `IOException` - 在 I/O 错误时

items.source: dst - the buffer into which bytes are to be transferred
items.translation: dst - 用于传输字节的缓冲区

items.source: pos - the position within the block at which the transfer is to begin
items.translation: pos - 传输开始位置在块中的位置

items.source: Fully read a sequence of bytes from this channel into the given buffer, starting at the given block position and filling remaining bytes in the buffer.
items.translation: 从该通道完全读取一个字节序列到给定的缓冲区，从给定的块位置开始，并填充缓冲区中的 remaining 个字节。

items.source:
Read a sequence of bytes from this channel into the given buffer, starting at the
given block position.
items.translation: 从该通道读取字节序列到指定的缓冲区，起始位置为指定的块位置。

items.source: Return the size of this block.
EOFException - if an attempt is made to read past the end of the block
items.translation: EOFException - 如果尝试读取超出块末尾

items.source: an InputStream to read the data block content
items.translation: 一个 InputStream` 用于读取数据块内容。

items.source: the number of bytes read, possibly zero, or -1 if the given position is greater than or equal to the block size
items.translation: 读取的字节数，可能为零，或者如果给定位置大于或等于块大小则为 `-1`

items.source: Provides read access to a block of data contained somewhere in a zip file.
items.translation: 提供对 ZIP 文件中某处包含的数据块的读取访问。
